signal: Filevine raised $400M led by Insight Partners and Accel, hit $205M ARR up 58% YoY, and grew to nearly 6,000 legal customers

email.body1:
Jeff, saw Filevine raise $400M, hit $205M ARR up 58 percent, and grow to nearly 6,000 customers.

Growth that fast usually means the bottleneck is not intent data, it is signal-to-action latency: by the time a rep acts, the moment has passed. Our AI SDR turns signals into researched, personalized outreach automatically, so the team converts more of the same data: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Filevine off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress around 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Jeff, quick follow-up for Filevine.

At your growth rate, RevOps usually knows where the funnel leaks but cannot get reps to act on signals fast enough, and data hygiene eats the hours that should go to follow-up. That latency is usually the biggest measurable drag on conversion.

Worth 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three things I would change. Our best practices alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent.
email.body3:
Jeff, last bit of proof for Filevine.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Filevine's reply rate likely compares to other high-growth SaaS firms. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Jeff, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If cutting signal-to-action latency is not a priority this quarter, no problem. Timing matters right after a raise, and I know scaling ops to match 58 percent growth is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your ops motion? I will tailor it to Filevine either way.
